abilities.span: Double the damage and healing of your spells.

dependencies.detail: 'Medivh' resolved to TIME_890 (Fabled bundle, ID prefix); 22 records contain 'Medivh' (Wild KAR_097 Medivh, the Guardian, hero skins)
dependencies.source_needed: client card relation; logs confirm only the ordinary case

dependencies.detail: R_AMOUNT_ORDER: Spell Damage / healing bonus added before or after doubling; doubling of healing turned into damage by Ruby Sanctum
dependencies.source_needed: a log with Atiesh plus a Spell Damage source or a healing bonus

decisions.question: Does 'control Medivh' mean the bundle minion TIME_890 or any card named Medivh?
alternatives: any minion whose name contains Medivh
decisions.discriminating_case: CONSEQUENCE-PILOT-1 saw the cost drop to 0 with TIME_890 on board; a Wild Medivh minion would discriminate

decisions.question: Order of Spell Damage and doubling for a '$4' spell with Spell Damage +1
decisions.discriminating_case: Medivh's Triumph with Atiesh and one Spell Damage minion: 10 or 9 to each minion

decisions.question: Is healing that Ruby Sanctum turned into damage doubled as healing, as damage, or not at all?
decisions.discriminating_case: CONSEQUENCE-PILOT-1 observed Flash Heal dealing 18 with Atiesh; the components were not decomposed
